description: Structured echo report: section order, SR routing by Finding Site, guideline cut-offs for measured values, and the AI findings that count as positive. Same file in PanEcho, EchoAlign, the PACS-AI viewer and CardioAgent; bump the version on every change.

srRouting.comment: Each SR measurement goes to a section by its Finding Site; measurementOverrides (matched on the measurement name, case-insensitive substring) win over the site. Sites not listed and not matched by a pattern go to 'other'; ignoredSites are not shown.

metrics.comment: How each graded value is read from the echo-sr-measurements result: a summary key, or measurements matched by site and exact measurement name (case-insensitive). 'antegrade' drops regurgitant-flow entries. 'prefer' picks the first entry whose method contains the word. scale multiplies the value.

measurement: left ventricle internal end diastolic dimension
left ventricle posterior wall diastolic thickness
left atrial end systolic volume index

derivedMetrics.comment: Indexed values computed when the SR has the volume and the body surface area (BSA, m²).

labels.en: Elevated E/e' (> 14): raised LV filling pressure likely
labels.fr: E/e' élevé (> 14) : pressions de remplissage VG probablement élevées

labels.en: Dilated IVC (> 2.1 cm): raised RA pressure possible
labels.fr: VCI dilatée (> 2,1 cm) : pression OD possiblement élevée

measuredRules.comment: Graded by echo-sr-measurements (asGrading): severe Vmax >= 4.0 m/s or MG >= 40 mmHg; moderate Vmax 3.0-3.9 or MG 20-39; mild Vmax 2.6-2.9; AVA < 1.0 cm² with non-severe gradients = discordant.

discordantLabel.en: AVA < 1.0 cm² with non-severe gradients (discordant: consider low-flow, low-gradient AS)
discordantLabel.fr: Surface < 1,0 cm² avec gradients non sévères (discordant : envisager une SA à bas débit, bas gradient)

labels.en: Short AR pressure half-time (< 200 ms): severe aortic regurgitation possible
labels.fr: PHT de l'IA courte (< 200 ms) : insuffisance aortique sévère possible

labels.en: Elevated mitral mean gradient (≥ 5 mmHg): mitral stenosis possible
labels.fr: Gradient moyen mitral élevé (≥ 5 mmHg) : sténose mitrale possible

labels.en: High mitral mean gradient (≥ 10 mmHg): severe mitral stenosis possible
labels.fr: Gradient moyen mitral très élevé (≥ 10 mmHg) : sténose mitrale sévère possible

labels.en: Elevated TR gradient (> 35 mmHg): pulmonary hypertension possible
labels.fr: Gradient IT élevé (> 35 mmHg) : hypertension pulmonaire possible

labels.en: High TR gradient (> 50 mmHg): pulmonary hypertension likely
labels.fr: Gradient IT très élevé (> 50 mmHg) : hypertension pulmonaire probable

labels.en: Pulmonic valve gradient ≥ 36 mmHg (moderate stenosis range)
Pulmonic valve gradient ≥ 64 mmHg (severe stenosis range)

labels.fr: Anévrisme de la racine aortique (≥ 5,0 cm)

aiRules.comment: AI findings that count as positive at the model's released or calibrated threshold. kind: multiclass (positive when the called class is in 'positive'; probability = sum of the positive classes), binary (PanEcho: positive when the released 0.5 rule calls 'positiveLabel'; probability of that label from binaryProbabilities when present), classification (EchoAlign: positive when called at the released threshold), ordinal (EchoAlign: positive when the grade is in 'positive'), regression (positive by the measured rule 'rule' applied to the AI estimate; band = MAE against the MHI SR), asCalibrated (PanEcho 1.1.3+ MHI-calibrated label).

PanEcho.key: Moderate or greater LV hypertrophy (increased wall thickness)
Any level of LV hypertrophy (increased wall thickness)

Moderately|Severely Decreased.en: Moderately or severely reduced LV systolic function
Moderately|Severely Decreased.fr: Fonction systolique VG modérément ou sévèrement réduite

Moderate|Severe.en: Moderate or severe LV diastolic dysfunction
Moderate|Severe.fr: Dysfonction diastolique VG modérée ou sévère

Significant AS likely, severe possible.en: Significant aortic stenosis likely, severe possible
Significant AS likely, severe possible.fr: Sténose aortique significative probable, sévère possible

Significant AS likely.en: Significant (moderate or severe) aortic stenosis likely
Significant AS likely.fr: Sténose aortique significative (modérée ou sévère) probable

grade_ii.fr: Dysfonction diastolique VG de grade II

grade_iii.fr: Dysfonction diastolique VG de grade III

text.en: Moderate or severe aortic stenosis suspected
text.fr: Sténose aortique modérée ou sévère suspectée

discordantAiNegative.en: discordant: not flagged by the AI estimate
discordantAiNegative.fr: discordant : non signalé par l'estimation IA

discordantMeasuredNormal.en: AI estimate flags it ({ai}) but the measured values are normal ({measured}): discordant, the measured values prevail
discordantMeasuredNormal.fr: l'estimation IA le signale ({ai}) mais les valeurs mesurées sont normales ({measured}) : discordant, les mesures prévalent

sexUnknown.en: Patient sex unknown: male cut-offs used for sex-specific thresholds (fewer false positives).
sexUnknown.fr: Sexe inconnu : seuils masculins utilisés pour les seuils selon le sexe (moins de faux positifs).

measuredSource.en: Measured values come from the sonographer's DICOM SR; graded by guideline cut-offs, not a physician interpretation.
measuredSource.fr: Les valeurs mesurées viennent du SR DICOM de l'échographiste ; classées selon les seuils des lignes directrices, pas une interprétation médicale.

aiDisplay.comment: Every AI output shown in the section bodies, in display order. band = mean absolute error against the MHI SR (PanEcho: panecho-calib, 392 studies, 1.1.x input; EchoAlign: 356-study benchmark / locked test), shown as ± band.

PanEcho.key: LV intraventricular septum thickness at diastole
LV posterior wall thickness at diastole
PanEcho.fr: Épaisseur de la paroi postérieure en diastole

PanEcho.key: Any level of LV hypertrophy (increased wall thickness)
Moderate or greater LV hypertrophy (increased wall thickness)

asScreening.comment: AV Vmax AI estimate MAE vs measured: PanEcho 1.1.3 corrected 0.68 m/s (locked test); EchoAlign raw 1.14 m/s (356 studies).
